info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: The External Agency Lookup API facilitates the retrieval of information regarding external banking agencies based on specified parameters. By accessing the correspondent bank directory, users can efficiently obtain detailed insights on banking partners. This API serves as a vital resource for financial institutions, fintech applications, and developers seeking to integrate banking agency data into their services. Typical use cases include validating agency information and enhancing transaction processes through third-party banking collaborations.

get.summary: Retrieve correspondent bank details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about a specific correspondent bank by providing its unique identifier. It helps users access essential banking information effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details about a correspondent bank by its unique identifier. The request should be formatted as JSON and must conform to the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the correspondent bank directory.

GetExternalAgencyByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body format for fetching the correspondent bank directory.

institutionId.description: Unique identifier for the financial institution.

agreementId.description: Identifier for the agreement associated with the bank.

bic.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) for the institution.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the institution.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the agreement becomes effective.

nostroAccountId.description: Identifier for the nostro account linked to the institution.

settlementCurrency.description: Currency used for settlements with the institution.

relationshipStatus.description: Current status of the relationship with the institution.

recordStatus.description: Status of the record in the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record.

GetExternalAgencyByParam1Response_200.description: Response schema for the GET operations on the external agency correspondent bank directory.

correlationId.description: Identifier to trace the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the response was processed.

Metadata.description: Metadata schema containing additional information about the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that processed the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer Authentication mechanism. Clients should provide a JSON Web Token (JWT) as a Bearer token in the Authorization header of their HTTP requests to gain access to protected resources.
